{{Top}} {{Character |type=First Order |image=[[File:DT-4431.png]] |name=Tophid Bruster |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' states that the [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|TIE fighter pilots]] of the [[First Order]] were all [[human]]s. As ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' identifies Tophid Bruster as a First Order [[TIE series|TIE]] [[pilot]], Bruster must be human. |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{Film|IX}} |pronouns=new |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin= |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=*[[First Order]]''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' **[[First Order starfighter corps]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Locked on target.|Bruster sights the ''Falcon''|{{FilmDate|IX|Bruster's appearance}}}} '''Tophid Bruster''', designated '''DT-4431''', was a [[lieutenant]] [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|TIE fighter pilot]] in the [[First Order starfighter corps|Starfighter Corps]] of the [[First Order]]. In [[35 ABY]], Bruster [[pilot]]ed a [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter]] as part of a group sent to destroy the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' while it was on a [[Mission to Sinta Glacier Colony|mission]] to the [[Sinta Glacier Colony]]. Bruster engaged the [[freighter]], but it ultimately escaped. ==Biography== {{Quote|Got one!''"
"''How many are left?''"
"''Too many.|Finn and Poe Dameron fight against Bruster's TIE group|}} [[Lieutenant]] Tophid Bruster was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|TIE Fighter Pilot]] with the designation DT-4431 who served in the [[First Order starfighter corps|Starfighter Corps]] of the [[First Order]] during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[Resistance]]. In [[35 ABY]], he flew in a [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter]] as part of a [[squadron]] sent to the [[Sinta Glacier Colony]] in order to track down the Resistance [[YT-1300 light freighter]] known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''. The [[TIE series|TIE fighters]] split up into several groups, with Bruster's moving down an [[Water|ice]] corridor within the [[Sinta Glacier|glacier]]. [[File:TophidBrusterCockpit.png|thumb|left|225px|Bruster piloted a TIE fighter within Sinta Glacier.]] The group spotted the ''Falcon'' docked further down the corridor, where its crew members [[Finn]], [[Poe Dameron]], [[Klaud]], [[R2-D2]] and [[Chewbacca]] were transferring data from the Resistance sympathizer [[Boolio]]. Bruster locked on to the vessel, but it undocked and began to escape, shooting down one member of Bruster's group and then crushing two other TIE fighters by causing part of the corridor's ceiling to collapse. The ''Falcon'' ultimately escaped the colony by flying through an ice wall and [[hyperspace skipping]] away. ==Equipment== Tophid Bruster wore the standard black [[First Order military uniforms|uniform]] and flight [[helmet]] of a First Order TIE pilot. The helmet had data projected onto its interior viewplate and the uniform's [[Armor|chestplate]] had a [[life support]] control center attached. ==Behind the scenes== Tophid Bruster was created for the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. ==Appearances== *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Galactic Guide]]'' {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Tophid Bruster}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Tophid Bruster |es=Tophid Bruster |ja=トフィッド・ブラスター |ka=ტოფიდ ბრასტერი }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Bruster, Tophid}} [[Category:First Order Navy officers]] [[Category:First Order pilots]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]]
